text:
Detroit comes in on a high: the Red Wings won 5-2 at Vancouver two days ago, are 3-0-2 in their last five and have points in six straight. They're missing Mason Appleton and Marco Kasper, and this is game three of a four-game road trip. Calgary beat Minnesota 2-1 last time out but is without Mikael Backlund (upper body), with Matt Coronato moving onto a line with Farabee and Sharangovich in his place. The Flames are better than their record, with a -19 goal difference against -4.2 expected, because finishing and goaltending have cost them.

At five on five the teams are close, with DET holding 52% of the expected goals (the quality of chances) and CGY 48%. Calgary also takes 4.7 penalties a game, and Detroit's power play creates 0.92 expected goals a game to the Flames' 0.45. In net, projected starter John Gibson (DET) is at -1.78 goals saved above expected this season after +10.11 last year. Devin Cooley (CGY) is at -0.21 after +17.23.

For Detroit, Alex DeBrincat is 39% to score and 69% for a point, and Lucas Raymond, the fourth pick in 2020, is 66% for a point. Our under-the-radar pick is Coronato, 53% for a point because his line creates chances, 3.78 expected goals per 60 with him on the ice. He's a player to watch, not a lock.
